summary.code_history_note: Checkout SHA changes may be state-only commits; unique checkout hashes are not unique source-code regimes.
limitations: Retrospective rules informed by prior cases: time splits are not independent validation.
Rolling 24h turnover differences are activity proxies, not interval trade volume or executed buying.
All-market cohorts include non-rallies; user cases never determine eligibility or labels.
Six-hour episodes overlap across rules; hit rates do not establish statistical superiority.
Ticker last snapshots are not executable prices, true intrabar extrema, fills or PnL.
Missing/gapped/right-censored outcomes remain unknown.
Liquidity and BTC screens are retained; research tags do not bypass spread, book, candles, risk or READY.
Older code/provenance regimes are distinct; quotes are not a candle-authenticity replay.
No transaction-cost profitability conclusion or production calibration is approved.
First recorded veto does not prove downstream gates passed.
Production HOT is prioritization, not READY or a forecast.
Daily or four-hour photo highs may be historical and are not timestamped executions.
Capacity is described only at recorded instants; missing books are unknown.
No causal calibration improvement, reliable paper PnL or profitable hypothetical trade is established.
Successful local replay does not repair scheduled-worker connectivity.
Screenshots are later visual observations, not proof that entry gates passed earlier.
Retained candidate records may describe prior episodes; dates must be checked.
Public payloads include open bars; only closed bars were counted in the review.
No real trades or Telegram messages were sent by either diagnostic.

Charts are 4h/daily and contain a current forming candle; a later rising or still-open chart candle is not a previous closed 15m READY qualification.

No complete future returns or independent after-cost holdout supports changing any threshold. A higher score or photographed rally alone does not justify calibration.
Previously scheduled quiet automation was observed disabled and was left unchanged; this review does not claim continuing background execution.
